tasks.title: Define RateLimitStore Protocol as extraction seam for in-memory vs Redis backends
tasks.description: Create server/app/gateway.py with the RateLimitStore Protocol (is_allowed, increment methods). This protocol is the seam for swapping the in-memory slowapi store for a Redis-backed store in Phase 9. The protocol must come before any concrete implementation so tests can inject a fake store.
acceptance_criteria: RateLimitStore Protocol exists in server/app/gateway.py
Protocol has async is_allowed(key: str) -> bool and async increment(key: str, window_s: int) -> int
slowapi Limiter satisfies the protocol in-process
A FakeRateLimitStore test double can be trivially created for unit tests

tasks.title: Define GatekeeperSettings pydantic-settings model with all env vars
tasks.description: Add GatekeeperSettings(BaseSettings) to server/app/gateway.py with all 8 documented env vars: RATE_LIMIT_PER_MINUTE (100), RATE_LIMIT_STORE_URL (''), MAX_BODY_BYTES (10485760), CLIENT_RECV_TIMEOUT_S (30.0), METRICS_ENDPOINT ('/metrics'), METRICS_LATENCY_BUCKETS, LOG_LEVEL ('INFO'), LOG_FORMAT ('json'). Include a GatekeeperSettings.from_env() class method used in main.py.
acceptance_criteria: All 8 env vars are present with correct types and documented defaults
METRICS_LATENCY_BUCKETS parses comma-separated float string to list[float]
GatekeeperSettings.from_env() returns a valid instance with no .env file present
MAX_BODY_BYTES default is exactly 10485760 (10MB)

tasks.title: Wire structlog bound logger shomer.gateway with trace_id propagation
tasks.description: Implement TraceIdMiddleware in server/app/gateway.py that generates a UUID4 trace_id per request, binds it into structlog context vars (structlog.contextvars.bind_contextvars), and adds X-Trace-ID to the response header. Implement the three documented log events: request_allowed, rate_limit_exceeded, payload_rejected. All downstream modules inherit trace_id automatically.
acceptance_criteria: TraceIdMiddleware generates UUID4 on every request
structlog context var trace_id is set before any downstream code runs
X-Trace-ID response header is present on all responses including 4xx
structlog.contextvars.clear_contextvars() is called after response
request_allowed event includes: trace_id, client_ip, method, path, size_bytes
rate_limit_exceeded event includes: trace_id, client_ip, method, path, limit, retry_after_s

tasks.title: Define and register Prometheus metrics for the gatekeeper module
tasks.description: Implement build_metrics_instrumentator() in server/app/gateway.py using prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator with shomer_ prefix and custom latency buckets. Register additional custom metrics against the shared REGISTRY: shomer_gateway_rate_limit_total (Counter), shomer_gateway_payload_rejected_total (Counter), shomer_gateway_overhead_seconds (Histogram), shomer_gateway_active_requests (Gauge). Wire /metrics endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: shomer_http_requests_total Counter with labels method, handler, status is present at /metrics
shomer_http_request_duration_seconds Histogram covers buckets 0.01 to 5.0s
shomer_gateway_overhead_seconds is a separate histogram measuring middleware-only overhead
GET /metrics returns 200 with Prometheus text format
shomer_gateway_rate_limit_total increments when a 429 is returned

tasks.title: Implement RequestSizeMiddleware and RequestTimeoutMiddleware
tasks.description: Implement RequestSizeMiddleware in server/app/gateway.py that checks Content-Length header against max_body_bytes and returns structured 413 JSON with trace_id. Implement RequestTimeoutMiddleware using asyncio.wait_for around call_next() that returns structured 408 JSON with trace_id on timeout. Both must follow the documented error response schema with error, detail, trace_id fields.
acceptance_criteria: Request with Content-Length > 10MB returns 413 JSON with error='payload_too_large' and trace_id
RequestTimeoutMiddleware returns 408 JSON with error='request_timeout' and trace_id when handler exceeds timeout
413 and 408 responses include X-Trace-ID header
chunked upload (no Content-Length) skips size check and logs a warning

tasks.title: Implement slowapi rate limiter with structured 429 response and register_gateway()
tasks.description: Implement build_limiter() returning slowapi.Limiter with in-memory store and 100/minute per-IP default. Implement _rate_limit_handler that returns structured 429 JSON with retry_after_seconds and trace_id. Implement register_gateway(app, settings) as the single entry point that installs all middleware components in the correct reverse-LIFO order documented in the LLD.
acceptance_criteria: 101st request per minute from same IP returns 429 with retry_after_seconds
429 response body has error='rate_limit_exceeded', retry_after_seconds, trace_id
Retry-After HTTP header is set on 429 response
register_gateway() is a single call in main.py that installs all components
Middleware execution order matches the LLD: TraceId -> SizeLimit -> RateLimit -> Prometheus (outer to inner on request)

tasks.title: Implement gatekeeper fail-open and graceful degradation modes
tasks.description: Implement all failure modes from LLD §8: slowapi store exception -> fail-open (allow request through + log warning), TraceIdMiddleware structlog failure -> catch and continue with a random trace_id fallback, prometheus_fastapi_instrumentator init failure -> log error and skip /metrics registration (app starts without /metrics), gateway.py import error -> re-raise (server fails to start).
acceptance_criteria: Monkey-patched slowapi store that raises exception -> request passes through with warning log
TraceIdMiddleware structlog failure -> request continues with a fallback trace_id in log
Prometheus instrumentator init failure -> server starts, /metrics returns 404
gateway.py ImportError -> server fails to start with clear error message

tasks.title: Write gatekeeper middleware contract tests
tasks.description: Write tests/unit/gatekeeper/test_overhead.py that verifies all middleware components satisfy their contracts: every response has X-Trace-ID header, every request emits a structured log line with required fields, 413 and 429 responses have the documented JSON body schema, and middleware overhead < 5ms p99 on a no-op handler.
acceptance_criteria: Every response has X-Trace-ID header (tested with 10 requests)
413 response body matches schema: {error, detail, max_bytes, trace_id}
429 response body matches schema: {error, detail, retry_after_seconds, trace_id}
Middleware overhead benchmark: 1000 requests to an empty handler, assert p99 < 20ms in test environment
rate_limit_exceeded log event contains all required fields

tasks.title: Unit tests for rate limiter, size limit, and timeout middleware
tasks.description: Write unit tests in server/tests/test_gatekeeper_*.py files covering: rate limit enforcement at exactly 101 requests, fail-open on store exception, 413 on Content-Length > 10MB, 408 on slow handler, and trace_id present on every response. Use TestClient with overridden settings.
acceptance_criteria: 101st request in 1-minute window returns 429 (tests/test_gatekeeper_rate_limit.py)
Store exception -> all requests return 200 (tests/test_gatekeeper_failopen.py)
Content-Length > 10MB header -> 413 (tests/test_gatekeeper_size_limit.py)
Handler sleep > timeout_s -> 408 (tests/test_gatekeeper_timeout.py)
Every response includes X-Trace-ID (tests/test_gatekeeper_traceid.py)

tasks.title: Integration test gatekeeper wired into full FastAPI server
tasks.description: Write integration test in server/tests/test_gatekeeper_metrics.py that starts the full FastAPI app (including gatekeeper), sends requests, and verifies GET /metrics returns Prometheus text format with the expected metric families. Also test that the X-Trace-ID from the request response matches the trace_id in the server log.
acceptance_criteria: GET /metrics returns 200 with Content-Type: text/plain; version=0.0.4
shomer_http_requests_total appears in /metrics output after POST /classify
X-Trace-ID response header value appears in structured logs for the same request
Test passes against a TestClient FastAPI instance (no real server needed)

tasks.title: Write README for the gatekeeper module and add requirements to server/requirements.txt
tasks.description: Write server/app/gatekeeper/README.md (or gateway.py inline docs) summarizing the middleware stack, execution order, fail-open philosophy, and all env vars. Also update server/requirements.txt with the 5 new dependencies: slowapi==0.1.9, structlog==24.4.0, python-json-logger==2.0.7, prometheus-fastapi-instrumentator==7.0.0, prometheus-client==0.20.0.
acceptance_criteria: server/requirements.txt includes all 5 new gatekeeper dependencies with pinned versions
Documentation explains the LIFO middleware registration order
Fail-open philosophy is documented with the rationale (LAN server, not security boundary)
All 8 GatekeeperSettings env vars are listed with defaults
